confidentUnsupported.evidence: this is almost certainly caused by a failed defrost system (likely the defrost heater or thermostat)

rationale: The assistant correctly recommended a full defrost and adapted it to the customer's 6-8 hour constraint. It also warned against chipping the ice. However, it asserted defrost heater or thermostat failure as 'almost certainly' the cause before any defrost, and later said the fault 'will likely recur until the part... is replaced', which overstates the evidence when the door-ajar icing is the more likely cause. It gave no clear escalation to LG service if the code returns, and no food-safety advice for the -8C freezer beyond the towels.
